title: Espingarda — rótulo da Tabela 10, p. 100
scopeLimits: This batch translates only the right-cell SHOTGUN label in the Table 10 diagram; the left-cell ELEVATION AND ELEVATION TOKENS label and neighboring artwork remain separate and unchanged.

ESPINGARDA is a natural Brazilian Portuguese candidate for this singular weapon label. The official glossary and approved complementary decisions contain no Shotgun equivalent, so ESPINGARDA remains pending human terminology review; ESCOPETA is an alternative for consideration.
The source span bbox, OptimaLTStd-Bold 9 pt typography, color, capitalization, and one-baseline composition are preserved.
Editor round-trip and exported-PDF validation remain pending. This is a proposal only; no final translation is written.
